svg.text: Proposal, not running UI · reference: KDE Dolphin · uses the accepted neutral surfaces, 8/12 radii, Inter and Lucide icons
Dark: icons view with Places, breadcrumb, view modes, information panel, zoom and free space. Light: details view in split panes with a transfer job strip.
Transfers show honest phase and progress with Cancel; conflicts and permission errors use the shared dialog. Selection is soft accent; focus keeps the accent ring.
Requires A1 transfer jobs, U1 dialogs, caller-scoped file services. Trash, tabs, archives and indexing follow A1 stages; nothing here implies they exist yet.
